استغثن (form X)
# اِسْتَغَثْنَ (istaḡaṯna) /is.ta.ɣaθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
# اُسْتُغِثْنَ (ustuḡiṯna) /us.tu.ɣiθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
# اِسْتَغِثْنَ (istaḡiṯna) /is.ta.ɣiθ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
